about: What Talk says from recordings: the landing page before anybody has signed in, and the urgent-help page, which anybody can open. Spoken from pre-recorded files (public/voice/onboarding), never generated per visit. Edit the text here, then run `npm run build:voice`. English is the source. The Wolof was drafted by the model, back-translated to check the meaning, and is marked draft until a Gambian translator has checked it — correct `wo` here and set `woDraft` to false.

lines.wo: Dalal ak jamm ci Talk Therapy.

lines.en: To begin a session with us, please sign in.
lines.wo: Ngir tambali ab session ak nun, ndax man nga sign in?
lines.woBack: To begin a session with us, can you sign in?

lines.en: You can use your email, or Google.
lines.wo: Mën nga jëfandikoo sa email, walla Google.
lines.woBack: You can use your email, or Google.

lines.en: To continue, the consultation is two hundred dalasi.
lines.wo: Ngir nu wey ci, consultation bi ñaari téméer dalasi la.
lines.woBack: For us to continue, the consultation is two hundred dalasis.

lines.en: Thank you. Now, let us begin.
lines.woBack: Thank you. Now then, let's start.

lines.en: Welcome back. Let us carry on.
If you are in danger right now, call one-one-seven for the police, or one-one-six for an ambulance.
lines.wo: Su fekkee ne yaa ngi ci danger léegi, woowl one-one-seven ngir police walla one-one-six ngir ambulance.
lines.woBack: If you are in danger right now, call one-one-seven for police or one-one-six for an ambulance.

lines.en: For a fire or an accident, call one-one-eight. These calls are free.
lines.wo: Su dee lakk-lakk walla accident, wooteel ci one-one-eight. Woote yooyu amul benn fey.
lines.woBack: If it is a fire or an accident, call one-one-eight. Those calls are free of charge.

lines.en: If you are under eighteen, tell an adult you trust today: a parent, a teacher, or a health worker.
lines.wo: Su fekkee amulo fukki at ak juróom-ñett, waxal tey ak mag boo wóolu: sa waajur, sa jàngalekat, walla liggéeykat bu wér-gi-yaram.
lines.woBack: If you are not eighteen, speak today with an adult you trust: your parent, your teacher, or a healthcare worker.

lines.en: You do not have to carry this on your own. Telling one person is often the hardest step, and the most useful.
lines.wo: Doo war a yenu li yaw rekk sa bopp. Wax ko kenn nit mooy la ëpp solo ak la gën a jafe.
lines.woBack: You should not carry this all by yourself. Telling someone is the most important and the hardest thing.
